# Descriptions
@@ 1
When the caster of this spell is a target of a spell from the realm of
Essence, the “incoming” spell must first make an RR before the caster makes an
RR. For RR purposes, each spell uses a level equal to the level of its caster.
If the “incoming” spell passes the RR, it may target the caster normally;
otherwise, the incoming spell has no effect on this target.
@@ 2
As Cancel Essence I, except affects spells from the realm of Mentalism.
@@ 3
As Cancel Essence I, except affects spells from the realm of Channeling.
@@ 4
Any active spell from the realm of Essence that is on the target must make a
RR (use the level of that spell’s caster as the spells level). If the spell
fails its RR, it is dispelled.
@@ 5
As Dispel Essence I, except affects spells from the realm of Mentalism.
@@ 6
As Dispel Essence I, except affects spells from the realm of Channeling.
@@ 7
As Dispel Essence I, except for the area of effect (centered on the caster).
If the radius encounters an already existing spell, the spell must make an RR
(with a special modifier of +30) or be cancelled (not dispelled) for as long
as the active spell is inside the radius.
@@ 8
As Dispel Essence Sphere I, except only Mentalism spells are affected.
@@ 9
As Dispel Essence Sphere I, except only Channeling spells are affected.
@@ 10
As Dispel Essence Sphere I, except radius is 50'.
@@ 11
As Dispel Mentalism Sphere I, except radius is 50'.
@@ 12
As Dispel Channeling Sphere I, except radius is 50'.
@@ 14
As Dispel Essence Sphere I, except radius is 100'.
@@ 15
As Dispel Mentalism Sphere I, except radius is 100'.
@@ 16
As Dispel Mentalism Sphere I, except radius is 100'.
@@ 17
Target has no Essence power points (and thus can throw no Essence spells) for
24 hours (this includes spells cast using spell bonus items). This can also be
cast against items which could normally cast spells. Hybrid spell casters who
have Essence as one of their realms only have access to half their normal
power points.
@@ 18
As Unessence, except Mentalism is affected.
@@ 19
As Unessence, except Channeling is affected.
@@ 20
As Cancel Essence I except all 3 realms are affected.
@@ 25
As Dispel Essence Sphere I, except radius is 300'.
@@ 30
As Dispel Essence I, except all 3 realms are affected.
@@ 50
As Dispel Essence Sphere V, except all 3 realms are affected.
